title.narrative: Output 3.2. Increased capacity of Member States to formulate and implement policies and strategies for creating decent work in the rural economy

description.narrative: The Limpopo Provincial Department of Public Works, Roads, and Infrastructure (LDPWRI) adopted and launched the Letsema Ditseleng Rural Road Improvement programme in September 2022.The programme promotes emerging contractor development and enhances rural employment opportunities, with a focus on women, youth, and people with disabilities. The programme, which aims to create employment opportunities for over 500, 000 people, was developed through a consultative process involving various state actors, including the LDPWRI, Roads Agency Limpopo (RAL), the Provincial department of Cooperative Governance, Human Settlements and Traditional Affairs COGHSTA; the South African Local Government Association (SALGA) and non-state actors. Building on the efforts initiated in the preceding biennium concerning consultations for the Letsema Ditseleng Rural Road Improvement programme, ILO continued its partnership with the Letsema Ditseleng Public Works and Roads Infrastructure (LDPWRI) in July 2022. The ILO facilitated a workshop dedicated to designing an implementation plan for the Letsema Ditseleng Rural Road Improvement Programme. The workshop also encompassed initiatives designed to advance employment-intensive construction practices and environmentally sustainable approaches, thereby promoting the adoption of climate-smart construction methodologies.
